title: Finding
description: Individual security finding identified during analysis.

id.title: Id
id.description: Unique identifier for the finding instance

title.title: Title
title.description: Concise, human-readable summary of the vulnerability

location.description: Code location where the vulnerability was detected

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: Concrete evidence from source code, AST, or config demonstrating the vulnerability

impact.title: Impact
impact.description: Security impact and potential exploit scenarios

recommendation.title: Recommendation
recommendation.description: Specific instructions for fixing the vulnerability

verification_steps.title: Verification Steps
verification_steps.description: Actionable verification steps to confirm the vulnerability is resolved

FindingLocation.title: FindingLocation
FindingLocation.description: File and line coordinates identifying where a vulnerability occurs.

file_path.title: File Path
file_path.description: Relative path of the source file where the issue was located

line_start.title: Line Start
line_start.description: Starting line number of the finding (1-indexed)

line_end.title: Line End
line_end.description: Ending line number of the finding (1-indexed)

snippet.title: Snippet
snippet.description: Source code snippet illustrating the context
